intro: Dinners feel richer when comfort meets charm. The Lyon chair, with its frame and seat, turns everyday meals into moments you linger over, supported, relaxed, and perfectly at ease.

features.title: Designed for visual harmony
features.text: Angular tapered legs and a clean frame line create a minimalistic yet stylish silhouette that elevates your dining setup without overwhelming it.

features.title: Cushioned for longer conversations
features.text: Thick foam cushioning (24 kg/m³ density) keeps you seated comfortably, so family meals and catch-ups stretch on without restlessness.

features.title: Mid-backrest with angular support
features.text: The angular design hugs your back gently, providing the right posture balance to keep you relaxed during everyday dining or weekend hosting.

features.title: Crafted in solid rubberwood
features.text: Strong rubberwood in a walnut shade ensures lasting durability, while adding natural warmth that pairs well with both modern and classic tables.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
